text: Objectives This program is designed for international students with bachelor degree who wish to understand urban-rural planning and development issues in China. The program provides solid theory and technological knowledge to students who will be able to engage in project development and management in the areas of urban-rural planning and design. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5 to 2 years. Research Areas 1. Urban Design Theory and Method 2. Urban-rural Planning Theory and Design Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 27 credits units. Of the 27 credits units required, 12 must be core courses, 10 must be elective courses, 3 must be thematic courses, and 2 must be practical courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
